references.title: Schabrun et al. — Texting and Walking: Strategies for Postural Control and Implications for Safety
references.scope: 2014 controlled study of 26 healthy adults on an approximately 8.5 m path. Reading/typing associated with slower walking and greater path deviation than no-phone walking. Not a measurement of this clip or population accident risk.
